newsitem.title: USA: Watson says to buy Oclassen Pharma.
newsitem.headline: Watson says to buy Oclassen Pharma.

text.p: Watson Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Thursday it had signed a definitive agreement to acquire Oclassen Pharmaceuticals Inc in a stock-for-stock transaction.
Watson said that under the agreement, Oclassen shareholders will get Watson common shares valued at $135 million, subject to a collar on Watson's stock price of $27 to $35 per share.
Watson said the deal is expected to be non-dilutive in 1997.
Oclassen, a privately held specialty pharmaceuticals company, it expected to generate revenue of about $34 million in 1996, according to Watson.
The company said the transaction, expected to close in late 1996, is to be accounted for as a pooling of interests and is subject to the approval of Oclassen's shareholders.
